objective: Reject intermittent green probes; require a fresh consecutive readiness window before synthetic candidate admission.

configuration.host: Local file in isolated headless Microsoft Edge

preconditions: Healthy GA and a compatible candidate are synthetic assumptions, not measured platform behavior.
Probes occur one tick apart only through tick six; missing and stale evidence is not success.
Every selected consecutive probe must be fresh and successful; thresholds are local lesson choices.
actions: Choose sequence, window, freshness and inspection tick
Inspect unsafe single-green comparison and retained traces
expectedAssertions: Flapping S F S F S S at tick six with a three-probe window remains HOLD although the single-green comparison would ALLOW.
A recovered fresh complete window permits exactly one final synthetic admission.
Known failures block; missing, insufficient and stale checks remain unknown in the required-check denominator.
Wrong answers fail the answer verifier but cannot force admission or erase earlier failures.
Invalid input/state or a ninth run is rejected without changing retained history.

verifier.scope: Local model consistency and actual DOM, keyboard, error, reset, failure and CSP behavior; not native validation.

tooling.helperLifecycleLimit: Not a fully qualified unattended runner; abandoned recovery prototype is unqualified.

userImpact: UNMEASURED for real users. Probe checks and the single final admission are synthetic; answer PASS is not migration success.
cleanup: Awaited isolated browser close in finally; lesson history is in memory only and explicitly resettable.
publication: Implementation commit and annotated kanban/A-S029/<12sha> marker are resolved by the authorized publisher; no self-referential commit hash is invented.
acceptance: Parent-owned independent review required; this worker cannot award Done.

nativeRemainder.blocker: CORE, DATA and HOST gates, qualified target/access, safe probe/admission fixtures and separate native execution authority are outstanding.

limits: No native Azure, real probes, production Node24 or source-parent certification.
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity, deployment, expenditure, package/framework change or download.
Ordinary verification preserves proof; CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 is deliberate append-only capture.
One frozen satisfier unit; tests, refinements and repeated checks earn no extra credit.
